environment.description: Same Terraform provider API binary deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. PostgreSQL 14 on Aurora with pg_qualstats extension active. Database connection uses role 'tfprovider_rls_scoped' which connects through PgBouncer (transaction mode). RLS policies are defined on tf_resources table with FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY enabled on the table owner role. The RLS policy uses current_setting('app.current_tenant') matched against tenant_id column. However, the application sets this via SET LOCAL at transaction start based on the session-derived tenantID (not the user-supplied targetTenant parameter). PgBouncer in transaction mode preserves SET LOCAL within the transaction boundary. The policy is: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON tf_resources USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant', true)) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant', true)). Table owner has ALTER TABLE tf_resources FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY applied. Note: the db role 'tfprovider_rls_scoped' is NOT the table owner so RLS applies to it. Cookie SameSite remains 'None' for CLI compatibility.

config.postgres_rls: enabled with FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY on table
config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON tf_resources USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant', true)) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant', true))
config.session_variable_binding: SET LOCAL app.current_tenant = <session_derived_tenant_id> executed at transaction start via connection middleware
config.force_rls: ALTER TABLE tf_resources FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
config.network: ALB with no WAF rules for CSRF
